name: arXiv API
tagline: Public Atom search API for arXiv preprint metadata and paper discovery
description: arXiv provides a free public HTTP API for programmatic access to metadata and search across the arXiv e-print repository. Queries return Atom XML with titles, authors, abstracts, categories, DOIs, and PDF/HTML links. No API key is required; usage is governed by Terms of Use rate limits (legacy APIs: one request every three seconds, single connection). Suitable for research tooling, literature search, and citation workflows; bulk dumps should use dedicated bulk-data channels instead of hammering the API.

auth.details: No authentication or API key required. Public unauthenticated HTTP GET. Terms of Use require polite rate limiting and a single concurrent connection for legacy APIs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Rate-limited only (legacy APIs: ≤1 request every 3 seconds, one connection).

rate_limits: Legacy APIs (arXiv API, OAI-PMH, RSS): no more than one request every three seconds; limit to a single connection at a time (Terms of Use). max_results capped at 30,000 per query (slices of at most 2,000). Limits may change.

example.response_snippet:

use_cases: search arXiv papers by keyword, title, author, or category
fetch metadata and abstract for a known arXiv ID
list recent preprints in a subject category
paginate search results for literature review tooling
resolve PDF and abstract URLs for citation or download workflows
